{
  "$schema": "https://code.claude.com/schemas/plugin.json",
  "name": "homie",
  "displayName": "Homie",
  "version": "0.45.0",
  "description": "Build games and apps with Homie’s engine packages, animated characters, sound, music and video skills. Play from a post on X. Publish on your own Cloudflare and connect your own Stripe with one approval. Open source.",
  "author": {
    "name": "Homie",
    "url": "https://homie.rocks"
  },
  "homepage": "https://homie.rocks/studios/",
  "repository": "https://github.com/homie-rocks/homie",
  "license": "Apache-2.0",
  "keywords": [
    "games",
    "multiplayer",
    "netplay",
    "cloudflare",
    "music",
    "sound",
    "sfx",
    "art",
    "3d",
    "models",
    "playtest",
    "performance",
    "video",
    "trailers",
    "studio",
    "mcp"
  ],
  "mcpServers": "./.mcp.json",
  "userConfig": {
    "paneAutoOpen": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Open the Studio pane when a build starts",
      "description": "The Studio pane (and the parts pane, when agents build in parallel) opens by itself when a build starts, where the terminal is wide enough for a pane nobody asked for (144 columns; 110 once you have opened it). /studio always opens it.",
      "default": true
    },
    "band": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "The studio band above the prompt",
      "description": "One line above the prompt inside a studio: the studio, the game, the build's step and %, a Play link and how many people are playing now. Nothing outside a studio.",
      "default": true
    },
    "guardFiles": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hold edits to protected files",
      "description": "An edit to a file that studio.json \"protect\" lists waits for your Proceed, with its diff.",
      "default": true
    },
    "guardDeploys": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hold production deploys",
      "description": "A deploy (homie-studio deploy, npm run deploy, wrangler deploy, studio_deploy, a media publish) waits for your Proceed, with what will change; so does a change to the studio's Cloudflare account outside its deploy (a delete, a secret, a hand rollout, a write to the live database, by Wrangler or Cloudflare's MCP).",
      "default": true
    },
    "guardSpend": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Hold paid media calls past the budget",
      "description": "A fal, ElevenLabs or Tripo call that would pass studio.json \"budget\", the build's budget or the job's cap (or whose cost cannot be read first: a provider's own CLI, MCP server or API) waits for your Proceed, with its estimated cost; so does downloading a Clef model through Ollama (ollama pull clef-flash, about 11 GB), with its size.",
      "default": true
    },
    "redactSecrets": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Take secrets out of tool output",
      "description": "Keys and tokens (Cloudflare, fal, ElevenLabs, GitHub and others, office keys, hap_ agent passes) are hidden from Claude in every tool result; one-time owner links go to the Studio pane instead.",
      "default": true
    },
    "renderResults": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Draw Homie's results natively",
      "description": "Setup status as a checklist, checks as rows, playtest verdicts, deploys with their live links, and Homie's commands named in words.",
      "default": true
    },
    "arcade": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "The arcade",
      "description": "/arcade plays a live Homie game in a pane (a headless Chrome seat on this computer, paused while the pane is hidden).",
      "default": true
    },
    "pictures": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Pictures in the terminal",
      "description": "\"blocks\" draws game frames as coloured character cells (every truecolor terminal); \"image\" draws real pixels where the terminal shows images (kitty, Ghostty, iTerm2, WezTerm).",
      "options": [
        "blocks",
        "image"
      ],
      "default": "blocks"
    }
  }
}
